title: Deferasirox HOF and its in situ metallization affording a new family of lanthanide coordination polymer-based MHOFs

material_class.structural_family: lanthanide coordination polymer-based MHOF with cruciform-like 1D chains

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.20 mmol) and DFX (0.2 mmol) in 10 mL H2O was stirred for 10 min at room temperature and transferred into a 20 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel. The mixture was heated at 180 °C for five days under autogenous pressure. After slow cooling to room temperature, yellow-green prism crystals of DFX-Ce were filtered off, washed with distilled water, and dried in air. No deprotonating reagent was used; pure water and lanthanide nitrate were required for crystallization.
synthesis.temperature: 180 °C (hydrothermal); stirred 10 min at room temperature before heating
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: slow cool to room temperature; yellow-green prism crystals filtered, washed with distilled water, dried in air

properties.summary: Solid-state DFX-Ce shows faint yellow-green photoluminescence (CIE 0.3452, 0.482) dominated by ligand π*→π emission at 553 nm (λex = 340 nm), blue-shifted versus free DFX, plus weaker Ce3+ 5d→4f bands at 700 and 759 nm. Ligand-to-Ce antenna transfer is inefficient.

measurements.conditions: solid state, λex = 340 nm; assigned to 5d1(2D3/2)→4f1(2F7/2) and 5d1(2D3/2)→4f1(2F5/2)

properties.summary: Variable-temperature χMT indicates weak intrachain antiferromagnetic coupling between neighboring Gd3+ ions via H2L- above ~3.5 K, with a possible ferromagnetic upturn below 3.5 K. Magnetization saturates near 14.15 Nβ at 2.0 K and 7 T. A significant magnetocaloric effect is observed, with -ΔSm = 12.75 J kg-1 K-1 at 2.0 K and ΔH = 7.0 T (below the 13.47 J kg-1 K-1 uncoupled two-Gd3+ limit).

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: 300 K, 1 kOe dc field; two uncoupled Gd3+ expected 15.76 cm3 K mol-1

measurements.name: saturation magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2.0 K, 7.0 T; theoretical 14.0 Nβ for two Gd3+

source_locations.location: Static magnetic property studies; Fig. 8; Fig. 9

material_class.structural_family: lanthanide coordination polymer-based MHOF with dimer fragments and cruciform-like 1D chains

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Tb(NO3)3·6H2O (0.30 mmol) and DFX (0.25 mmol) in 10 mL H2O was stirred for 10 min at room temperature and transferred into a 20 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel vessel. The mixture was heated at 200 °C for six days under autogenous pressure. After slow cooling to room temperature, yellow-green prism crystals of DFX-Tb were filtered off, washed with distilled water, and dried in air. Two guest water molecules were included in the formula on the basis of TG and elemental analysis after SQUEEZE.

synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: slow cool to room temperature; yellow-green prism crystals filtered, washed with distilled water, dried in air

properties.summary: DFX is an efficient sensitizer for Tb3+. Solid-state DFX-Tb shows bright green 4f→4f emission (CIE 0.331, 0.602) with no residual ligand fluorescence. Lifetime 0.599 ms; absolute QY 10.81%, much higher than DFX-Eu because the ligand triplet matches the Tb3+ resonance level.
